critique: The dark violet/blue palette and luminous particle quality are appropriate, and the two frames clearly differ, showing animation. However, the portal is not yet readable as a complete glowing annulus: both frames show only partial particle arcs/swept trails, with large missing sections of the circle. The dust is visible but reads as the main arc itself rather than fine debris emanating from an already-established ring edge.

suggestions.why: Complete a full circular emitter sweep within one second so the persistent particles establish a readable full portal ring rather than a short arc.
Retain particles for longer than a full sweep so the annulus remains continuous and bright while the emitter keeps circulating.
Distribute the short-lived violet dust around the entire established ring edge instead of concentrating it along one partial sweep.
